title: No two props identical: per-instance size, offset, rotation and value jitter
note: Masonry and props are instanced with per-instance colour or unique scale and rotation; tiled repeats are a standing rejection.
intent: "Visibly tiled repeating masonry", "stepped grey boxes" and rows of identical props are standing rejections — repetition is the defect, not coarseness. Build stone as ≥ 40 individually placed blocks with per-block size jitter ±20%, position offset ±15% and colour jitter ±8% in HSL lightness (≥ 3 value steps across a run); never UV-repeat one texture more than 3× along a face, and break it with a second noise layer at a non-integer scale ratio such as 1 : 2.7; interrupt every ≥ 4-unit run of identical modules with a buttress, gap or differing course height. Distant massing gets a rotated base (±15° yaw), ≥ 2 stacked volumes of differing footprint and a roof form, faded by fog rather than flattened to boxes. Share one geometry and one material across the instances — a material per object is the draw-call explosion — and carry the variation in instance matrices and instanceColor.

check.js: (() => { const ms = meshes('block'); if (!ms.length) return false; const inst = ms.filter(m => m.isInstancedMesh); if (inst.length) return inst.every(m => m.count >= 40 && !!m.instanceColor); if (ms.length < 40) return false; const sig = m => m.scale.x.toFixed(2) + ',' + m.scale.y.toFixed(2) + ',' + m.rotation.y.toFixed(2); return new Set(ms.map(sig)).size >= ms.length * 0.8; })()
check.note: Masonry/props tagged block are >= 40 instances with per-instance colour (instanceColor) or >= 80% unique scale/rotation signatures; tiled repeating masonry and identical props are standing rejections.

port: Use one InstancedMesh per material family in the props/buildings module, tag it "block" (or tag ≥ 40 individual meshes so the signature test can run), and draw all jitter from the seeded rng so the variation is deterministic across builds.

evidence.note: bridge/town runs: ≥40 individually placed blocks, size jitter ±20%, colour jitter ±8% HSL lightness, texture repeat ≤3 broken at a 1 : 2.7 ratio; distant massing yaw ±15° with ≥2 stacked volumes; reuse geometries and materials
per-instance offsets: position ±15%, scale ±20%, albedo ±10%, never tile the same UV set more than 3× along a face
repetition is the defect: vary per-instance value (±3 steps), width/height jitter, break every ≥4-unit run of identical modules
briefs state a variation budget: ≥4 size classes, ≥3 facade widths, per-instance offset/rotation ranges, no visible repeat at ≥8 m
